PROJECT ARES - playtest build

1. Unzip this folder anywhere and run ProjectAres.exe.
   (Windows may warn about an unknown publisher: More info > Run anyway.)
2. Open your phone (P) and go to the Servers app. Pick your own player name
   there first: every player on a server needs a different name.
3. Under "A friend's server", type the host's address and press Join.
4. Everyone must be on the same build as the host. If you see "The server runs
   a different version of the game", download the newest build.

Report bugs with: what you did, what happened, what you expected, where, and
the build name (the zip's file name).
